supported_scope: Summation over disjoint global centers and composition with the expressly separate topological, bracket and weight hypotheses.

claim_assessments.reason: Distinct centers give disjoint global divisor sets, so sum b_T<=sum N_T<=tau. Finiteness of all places comes from the representation argument, not this inequality alone.
Adding the separate Section 05 topological inequality gives the branch inequality. The c_2 terms are surface-cycle ranks, not Chern numbers.
Junction nonnegativity additionally needs local bracket deficits, d_h>=1 and distinct positive weights; termination needs further monotonicity/descent and relative-program results not reviewed here.

concrete_unresolved_obligations: The Section 05 topological inequality is an antecedent, not proved by the curve-place draft or finite verifier.
The Section 07 bracket and positive-weight hypotheses, finite support, descent and separate relative programs are not independently certified here.
not_established: An unconditional branch-topology proof from finite arithmetic
A non-Kahler branch or junction theorem
